earlierFailures.event: An earlier Editor session closed normally; subsequent tools/list returned zero until a live instance was available.

Pipeline dependency disappeared from the working manifest before test execution (local modification time 19:31:23 KST). A later domain reload could not load Microsoft.CodeAnalysis and the first PlayMode run failed 6/6. The responsible writer was not established. The original failure logs were retained locally.
After restoring the exact package, the isolated copy and the actual working project each passed the 6 PlayMode tests. A fresh actual-project EditMode run passed 52/52.

Global unity status sometimes returned STATUS_NO_INSTANCES while the explicitly targeted Editor answered ready. Use the project-qualified editor_status and actual MCP calls for connection verification.
